name: Research Paper Structure
description: Structures research papers in IMRaD format (Introduction, Methods, Results, and Discussion) or social sciences format with section-by-section guidance, producing a complete paper framework. Use when the user asks to structure a research paper, write an academic paper, organize a study for publication, or create an IMRaD paper. Do NOT use for literature reviews (use literature-review), abstracts only (use abstract-writing), or editing an existing paper (use academic-paper-review).
